source: ISO 32000-2 §11.6.4.3: "The name None may be specified in place of a soft-mask dictionary, denoting the absence of a soft mask. summary: The page group's /K is never read. The page /Group is read for /S and /CS only and enclosing_knockout starts as None, so a page stating /K true composites its elements with one another: a blue square at ca 0.5 over a red one reads (127,63,191) at the overlap where the knockout page group gives (127,127,255). Nothing is reported.
source: ISO 32000-2 Table 147, K: "If this flag is false , later objects within the group shall be composited with earlier ones with which they overlap; if true , they shall be composited with the group's initial backdrop and shall overwrite ( \"knock out\") any earlier overlapping objects." Table 147 alters only /I and /CS for a page group; §11.4.7: "The page group shall be treated as an isolated group".
